current.name: Providers and API synchronization core
current.validation_rule: Phase 0 documentation must be explicitly reviewed by the maintainer before application implementation starts.

lot_5_approved_concepts.provider_model: Adapter plus provider instance plus provider/championship synchronization stream
lot_5_approved_concepts.championship_discovery: Automatic where possible, visible as discovered but never auto-synchronized before manual activation
lot_5_approved_concepts.manual_configuration: Adapter-specific form when automatic discovery is unavailable or insufficient
lot_5_approved_concepts.per_championship_source_config: Adapter-specific source configuration supports different endpoints and strategies within the same provider; WRC is a known OCBlackTop example, not an architectural exception
lot_5_approved_concepts.bootstrap: Current year first across active championships in round-robin, then historical backfill in background
lot_5_approved_concepts.historical_depth: Discover seasons where possible; otherwise N-1 recursively until a confirmed empty season, with optional manual start year
lot_5_approved_concepts.current_loop: Scan from January 1 through available current-year data, then restart from January 1 continuously
lot_5_approved_concepts.scheduler: Persistent round-robin scheduler with provider-specific cursor and lease per stream
lot_5_approved_concepts.quota_cadence: Automatically computed from configured/observed short-term and monthly limits, remaining budget, reset time and active streams
lot_5_approved_concepts.quota_reserve: 30 percent of monthly quota reserved for current-year work by default
lot_5_approved_concepts.quota_unknown: No automatic synchronization without known safe limits unless reliable provider limits are exposed
lot_5_approved_concepts.retry: Exponential backoff plus jitter for transient failures; suspend on durable auth/configuration failure
lot_5_approved_concepts.secrets: Encrypted in database with environment master key, authenticated encryption, nonce and key_version
lot_5_approved_concepts.source_policy: One principal provider per championship in V1
lot_5_approved_concepts.normalization: Adapter normalization plus stored mappings; ambiguous relationships require manual association
lot_5_approved_concepts.idempotence: Stable external ID first, safe business key second, normalized provider hash for unchanged detection
lot_5_approved_concepts.corrections: Provider values continue to update but existing local override remains effective
lot_5_approved_concepts.missing_events: Alert after three complete missing cycles by default; never automatically delete
lot_5_approved_concepts.disabled_championship: Keep data and admin visibility, stop synchronization, exclude from public API; priority current-year refresh on reactivation
lot_5_approved_concepts.logs: Durable run summary in PostgreSQL plus structured technical logs with rotation/compression
lot_5_approved_concepts.logo: Local championship logo upload belongs to championship and is never overwritten by provider

deliverables: Migration plan if schema changes are necessary
ADR only for durable new architecture decisions
phase_0_required.stop_rule: Phase 0 documentation is complete. Codex must stop after commit and push and wait for explicit maintainer validation before sub-lot 5.1.

next_action.task: Audit and explicitly validate the Lot 5 Phase 0 specification, acceptance matrix and impact analysis. No application implementation is authorized before that validation.
